hooks.name: Reseed demo data after server edits
hooks.description: Reminds Kiro that saving server.py wipes the in-memory demo data, so it reseeds and re-verifies incidents and re-checks the public privacy rules.

action.prompt: server.py was just saved. uvicorn --reload restarts the app and wipes the in-memory DETECTIONS list. Before presenting results: run `.venv/bin/python seed_demo.py 20`, log in as officer/boston123, verify about 6 detections via POST /api/detections/{id}/status (status=verified), and confirm /api/detections returns verified incidents. Also re-check that public_view() still excludes coordinates, location, locality and video_url.
